source_edit_policy: workspace-wide; fixed experiment conditions and resource budget required
fixed_config:
data:
  train_files: /workspace/data/train.parquet
  val_files: /workspace/data/test.parquet
  train_batch_size: 4
  max_prompt_length: 1024
  max_response_length: 256
  filter_overlong_prompts: true
actor_rollout_ref:
  model:
    path: /workspace/model
    use_remove_padding: false
    enable_gradient_checkpointing: true
  actor:
    ppo_mini_batch_size: 4
    ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 2
    use_torch_compile: false
    entropy_coeff: 0.0
    use_kl_loss: false
    optim:
      lr: 0.000001
    fsdp_config:
      param_offload: false
      optimizer_offload: true
  ref:
    log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 2
    fsdp_config:
      param_offload: false
  rollout:
    name: vllm
    n: 4
    tensor_model_parallel_size: 1
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.2
    num_gpu_blocks_override: 73836
    max_model_len: 1280
    max_num_batched_tokens: 2048
    max_num_seqs: 16
    enforce_eager: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 2
    temperature: 1.0
algorithm:
  adv_estimator: grpo
  kl_ctrl:
    kl_coef: 0.0
custom_reward_function:
  path: /workspace/reward.py
  name: compute_score
trainer:
  n_gpus_per_node: 1
  nnodes: 1
  total_training_steps: 10
  total_epochs: 6
  logger: [console]
  test_freq: -1
  save_freq: 10
  resume_mode: disable
  project_name: memory_experiment
  experiment_name: run
